[u][i][color=#dd7e6b]how to use:[/color][/i]
[/u]     1. download this mod and its requirements; 
     2. unzip the .zip file and drag and drop into your mods folder;
     3. open the game; and
     4. access the wallpapers using the catalogue (not the furniture catalogue) or use CJB item spawner.

I can't recommend Happy Home Designer enough... so if you like decorating your home, please get that mod as it will make decorating so much easier.
